Privacy at DevTools Forge

DevTools Forge is built so there is almost nothing to say here: the tools run entirely in your browser and never upload your files. When you merge PDFs or format JSON, the data stays on your machine and is never transmitted to us or to anyone else.

What we store

The site sets one strictly-necessary cookie to remember that you accepted the cookie notice. We run no analytics and no advertising, and we set no tracking cookies of any kind.

Contact

Questions about privacy can go to hello@devtools-forge.test, or read the getting-started guide to see how the tools work.
